claim: The README's GPU quickstart trains the Go2 walk for 150 iterations so the session ends in minutes, and 150 iterations do not learn to walk: an agent driving the whole loop through the plugin trained go2-walk-150 at the IIT chirp fit (reward 65.6 at the end), and the policy survived 8/8 trials and tracked 0/8, exact 95 % CI [0.00, 0.37]; the earlier runs of the same session on 2026-10-04 also tracked 0/8.
argv: claude -p <the whole-loop request> --plugin-dir <checkout> [the agent's calls: train_walk(task='go2-walk', recipe='full', fit=<the identified fit>, iterations=150); evaluate_walk(checkpoint='go2-walk-150', trials=8)]

outcome.policy: go2-walk-150-model_149, 150 iterations of the full recipe at fit@3a80294c6688 (the IIT chirp fit, 31/36 parameters pinned), 259 s
outcome.repeats: the same session's runs on 2026-10-04 (two projects) also tracked 0/8

protocol: evaluate_walk: paired seeded episodes, success = survived and error ratio < 0.5
caveats: a smoke-scale run for a quickstart: the full recipe trains 8000 iterations by default; the Go2 walker that tracks 38/40 trained 1500
eight trials bound the success rate only to [0.00, 0.37]
